{¶ 17} On June 15, before the expiration of the moratorium, the village

council passed an ordinance extending i it for an additional 180 days. See L Lordstown

Ord. No. 29-2026, available at Village of Lordstown,

https://www.lordstown.com/wp-content/uploads/29-2026-1.pdf (accessed Sept.

17, 2026) [https://perma.cc/NT5M-5JSU].

{¶ 49} For the foregoing reasons, we deny relators’ motion for leave to file

rebuttal evidence, grant relators’ motion for judicial notice, and deny the writ.

Writ denied.

Section 7: That the Village of Lordstown Council hereby imposes a moratorium on new permits
for Data Centers for a period not to exceed one-hundred-and-eighty (180) days from the effective date
of this Ordinance and directs that no permits shall be issued for these facilities during the 180-day
period during the moratorium.
